title: Timing-safe auth: dummy bcrypt always runs for unknown usernames
description: reader/store/credentials.rs:99-113: check() always runs bcrypt::verify() even for unknown usernames, using a precomputed dummy hash. This prevents timing oracles that distinguish 'user not found' from 'wrong password'. A contributor simplifying this to short-circuit on missing user would re-introduce the timing leak. Defend this unconditionally.
